Concerns Regarding Professionalism in Patient Handling
Observations on Clinic Professionalism

During my recent experience at the clinic, I observed a lack of professional attitude towards patients. My massage appointment was scheduled for 10:00 am; however, upon arrival, I found that the clinic had not yet opened. I waited for 20 minutes, after which I decided to leave due to the delay. Subsequently, I received a phone call at 10:57 am, asking me to return to the clinic.

This sequence of events raises questions about the professionalism expected from a facility operating within the medical field. While patients are often required to adjust to the clinic's timings and schedules, such incidents are typically addressed with nothing more than an apology. This leads to concerns about the clinic’s commitment to maintaining high standards of professional conduct.

I understand that this may be perceived with indifference, and perhaps I will once again receive a response expressing regret, such as "We are very sorry for what has happened." Ultimately, only time will reveal the outcome.
